summary: Wave 2 Phase 2 is accepted after one small acceptance fix. The four required provider-adapter guard tests pass, the CodeCamp streaming-protocol and Primary new-generator caller regressions pass, ai/storage type-checks pass, storage and webhooks aggregate tests pass, Primary full Vitest passes with 56/56 tests, and a Reading AI-adjacent Jest test now passes after adding the @reading-advantage/ai/internal-sdk Jest mapping and updating that test's mock to match the repointed import path. Provider boundaries are honestly partial: the public AI barrel has zero raw SDK re-exports and new direct vendor SDK imports fail the guard, while the internal-sdk quarantine and the 621 console.error ratchet are documented Wave-6-owned follow-ups, not overstated as complete enforcement. The broad ai aggregate remains red only from the already-known 19 ai_sdk_major_migration artifact/version tests, not from Phase 2 provider changes.
nonblocking_findings: The broad closeout command `CI=true pnpm turbo run test --filter=@reading-advantage/ai --filter=@reading-advantage/storage --filter=@reading-advantage/webhooks` exits 1 because @reading-advantage/ai still has the known 19 pre-existing failures in phase-0-setup/phase-11-sdk-version-contract/phase-12-closeout-artifacts. Storage (16/16) and webhooks (82/82) pass when run without the intentionally-red AI package; the Phase 2-specific AI guard files pass. Owner: ai_sdk_major_migration debt / Phase 3+ test-signal cleanup, not Phase 2 provider enforcement.

The AI `internal-sdk` subpath remains a documented quarantine loophole: production code can import raw vendor SDK helpers through `@reading-advantage/ai/internal-sdk`, and the provider guard deliberately allowlists `packages/ai/src/internal-sdk.ts`. Plan rows mark full AIClient adoption and quarantine removal as `[b] deferred:wave6`, so this is honest partial enforcement rather than an acceptance blocker for Phase 2.

The observability guard is a ratchet, not a full cleanup: `CONSOLE_ERROR_BASELINE = 621` remains, and Wave 6 owns the console.error to structured-logger sweep. An injected probe increasing the count to 622 failed as expected, so Phase 2 protects against regressions without claiming zero console.error call sites.

During acceptance, `CI=true pnpm --filter reading-advantage exec jest __tests__/ai/level-test-contract.test.ts --runInBand` initially failed because the Phase 2 repoint moved the controller import to `@reading-advantage/ai/internal-sdk` but Reading Jest only mapped/mocked the public barrel. Fixed and committed in `9de4a22c` by adding the subpath mapper and updating the test mock; final rerun passed 4/4.

Webhooks tests still emit existing stderr about DATABASE_URL being unset and mocked lesson-completion failures while passing 82/82 tests; this was already identified as a false-green risk in the Wave 2 strategy and is not new Phase 2 behavior. Owner: Wave 3/Phase 3 test signal and webhooks reliability follow-ups.
